title: Establish prompt-set drift detector for shadow + A/B traffic
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, production-safe detector that measures prompt-set quality drift for canary, A/B, and shadow traffic. The detector will run continuously on incoming production-like traffic, compute per-prompt-set score deltas against the golden baseline, surface meaningful regressions in Console, and optionally feed signals to rollout automation (pause/cancel canaries or trigger human review). This ticket covers the detection algorithm, telemetry schema, Console tiles/alerts, and the integration hook for the rollout pipeline. Focus is on high precision (low false positives) and easy configurability per-customer route.
acceptance_criteria: Daily drift score per configured prompt-set computed and stored for at least 90 days
Configurable thresholds: warning and critical; default warning = 2 sigma, critical = 3 sigma
Console dashboard tile shows drift timeline, per-model-variant breakdown, and recent failing prompts
Alerts flow to #sig-inference and oncall when critical threshold sustained for 2 consecutive evaluation windows
Automatic tagging of canary/A-B/shadow runs in metrics to attribute drift to route and traffic type
Rollout integration point implemented: an API endpoint that returns pass/warn/fail and human-readable reason for gating automation
E2E test with synthetic drift (schema in tests/ci/fixtures) and a matching GitHub PR that adds tests
implementation_notes: Aggregate: compute per-prompt metrics (score, token-level logprob, hallucination flags) and store time series at daily and hourly rollups
Baseline: maintain golden baseline distributions per prompt-set created from last stable model release; support rolling baselines
Detector: use two-sided KS for distribution shift + robust median delta for central tendency; combine into a single drift score via weighted sum
Precision tuning: add minimum-sample gating to avoid noisy alerts on low-volume routes
Privacy: strip customer identifiers from payloads before storing prompt-level metadata; only store prompt-set name and hashed prompt id
Performance: run detection job in batch hourly with incremental updates; target job runtime < 3m for 1M daily eval rows
Integration: expose /v1/rollout-drift?model_variant=&route=&window=24h returning JSON (pass|warn|fail) and top N contributing prompts
risks_and_mitigation: False positives from low-volume routes -> mitigation: min-sample threshold + aggregated warning stage before fail
Data privacy concerns -> mitigation: hashing + retention policy (90 days) + opt-out flag for Private customers
Compute cost for hourly run -> mitigation: incremental windowing and configurable cadence per-tenant
Model changes that change metric semantics -> mitigation: baseline re-calibration step and capture model-version metadata with each run
